instruction: Describe the impact of data leakage on a machine learning model.
input: Data leakage can significantly degrade the performance of a machine learning model. It can lead to overfitting, where the model performs well on the training data but poorly on new data. This is because the model has learned the noise in the training data instead of the underlying patterns.
output: Data leakage impacts a machine learning model by causing it to overfit. Overfitting occurs when the model learns too much from the training data, including noise, which makes it perform exceptionally well on the training set but poorly on new, unseen data. This is because the model has memorized the details of the training data rather than understanding the general patterns.

instruction: Describe the advantages and disadvantages of using PEFT (Pipelined Fine-Tuning) over full fine-tuning in terms of training speed and model size.
